
[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- non-analog_pin.volt:2[/red bold]

GPIO 21 does not have an ADC channel — cannot be used as Analog.

 [dim]2 |[/dim]     pin x: Analog = 21
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: ADC1 (safe with WiFi): GPIO 32-39. ADC2 (blocked by WiFi): GPIO 0, 2, 4, 12-15, 25-27.[/cyan]
